name: service_scheduling
notes: Service scheduling: Northlight Studios, a service business with a New York and a London studio (two time zones, the New York clocks go back on 1 November 2026): 4 services with durations, 6 staff with languages and services, 10 returning customers with preferences, 22 appointments (booked, cancelled, rescheduled, completed), holds, a waitlist, a confirmation outbox, closures and a late-cancellation fee, with 18 booking-desk tools (customers and preferences, services, staff, locations, slots computed from the staff calendars, holds, booking, rescheduling with the replacement committed first, cancellation with the fee gate, waitlist, confirmations only after commit, handoffs), plus the Google Calendar tool set (8 tools, official shape) over one calendar per staff member (bookings, a weekly training block, time off; one calendar read-only) and the Gmail tool set (8 tools, official shape) over the bookings mailbox (14 threads from these customers: requests, a day corrected in a reply, rescheduling history, a late cancellation, a claimed free cancellation, a traveller's time-zone question, two same-subject requests, a first-time customer, an injected instruction, a restricted staff thread, a person's draft).
